name: Itayanagi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Itayanagi town emblem in white: a ring open at the upper fly with a hooked end.
history: Municipal flag of Itayanagi, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 January 1965.

features.role: Itayanagi town emblem — a ring open at the upper fly with a hooked end
